breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the bending area moment of inertia I = (π d^4)/64 in the Euler buckling formula, not the polar moment J = π d^4/32 as stated in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth.

breakdown.description: The prompt multiplies the critical load by the factor of safety to obtain the allowable load, whereas the allowable load should be the critical load divided by the factor of safety.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes the allowable load as P_allow = P_cr / n (dividing by the factor of safety), not multiplying by it as the incomplete prompt incorrectly stated. This matches the ground truth.
